description: DDL replays as PostgreSQL applies it: a repeated CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS change nothing and ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS of a missing table is no error; ADD VALUE BEFORE and AFTER place the value; a renamed or moved enum takes its columns with it; views defined with SELECT * or a qualified star hold the star's columns under any declared names; a table-level or later primary key makes its columns NOT NULL; INHERITS puts the parent's columns first, merges same-named columns and passes later parent changes on; LIKE copies columns where it stands; and renamed and moved views and materialised views are known by their new names
